description:
Search this company's already cached official filings, page by page.

    Use after get_stock_events/get_filing_extract when you need historical context, such as a
    prior commissioning date, original order announcement, customer, project, or tender. This is
    cache-only: it never downloads a filing or triggers extraction. Results retain a source page
    and original BSE attachment URL; `coverage` tells you how much page-preserving history is
    indexed and explicitly reports parsed legacy filings that cannot be searched reliably yet.
name: search_company_disclosures
